measurement: Series absolute-delay characterization of BNC-to-two-wire clip-terminal Adapter A and Adapter B
sign_convention: PicoScope CHB minus CHA; positive means the series path arrived later

apparatus.reference_path: CLOCK-SPLITTER-01 branch directly to PicoScope CHA
apparatus.series_path: CLOCK-SPLITTER-01 branch through straight female-to-female BNC barrel, Adapter A, signal-to-signal and shield-to-shield clip junctions, Adapter B, then PicoScope CHB

branch_swap_analysis.method: The orientation midpoint cancels signed splitter-branch skew while retaining PicoScope CHB-minus-CHA skew and the complete barrel-plus-adapter series delay.

adapter_sum.calculation: orientation midpoint - PicoScope CHB-minus-CHA correction - barrel delay

adapter_difference.calculation: half-difference of the two fitted FIRE-to-Q-SWITCH intercepts; fit intercept standard errors propagated
